AWOL1.synopsis: Roper's warning comes true: the Wildcats have declared war on the UCPD and snatched officers Johnson and Beck, threatening to shoot them unless the police back off. The streets around the Rio canal are sown with military-surplus mines. Roper turns up ('you ain't the only friend I got in the UCPD'): Darci frees Johnson and walks him to the safe zone, then play passes to Roper, who carries the wounded Beck back. Overheard: the Southside Wildcats have 'all KIND o' artillery' cooking for the UCPD.
characters: Wildcat captors, a mocking punk, a tramp who hands out a gift, a civilian held by a Wildcat

mission2.synopsis: The Chief sends every officer to Southside, where crime is soaring and three cops are already down. Darci, partnered with the joking Officer Green, has to drive the crime rate down: dealers, a stalker, a Wildcat (Sweeney) about to settle a score with Fish, an arms handover to Mr Shultz, and Griz executing Walker for talking to Gordansky at Mable Greer's diner. A body turns up with chunks of flesh missing. Roper finally explains himself: the Wildcats aren't the root of it; they're controlled by an outside, far more potent force, and he'll help destroy them. Green and Roper must survive.
characters: **Officer Green**: partner, too fond of jokes
**Griz** and **Walker**: Walker killed for talking to Gordansky
**Mr Shultz**: buyer at an arms deal
Dealers, a stalked woman, a sceptical cop ('just street scum'), a woman hoping Banes cleans up the subway

park2.synopsis: Neighbourhoods are blowing up all over town, and a large armed force of Wildcats marches on Central Park and UCPD HQ beside it. Roper joins Darci, and together they take down the storm squads, the 'Falcon group', the park murder squad, a lone psycho and the Wildcat kingpin's crew. The kingpin turns out to be a diversion: if any squad reaches HQ's main doors, the station falls. Citizens ask whether a cult is behind the madness and where the National Guard is. (The original plays a video here; its bats are compiled out.)
characters: Storm squads, the Falcon group, the murder squad
Cops defending HQ; citizens filming for UCNN

MIB.synopsis: A body cut apart by hundreds of bullets lies by Mable Greer's Diner in Southside, and City Hall wants five clues. Officers Harney and Estevez are on the scene; a second body, Albert Haines the bootlegger, turns up, and Pete's wife is looking for her husband. Darci follows the trail: a diner napkin, a Dancing Fool nightclub brochure, a note to 'meet Claavus at the Vote Bane sign' in the park, a 'Claavus eyes only' file, and a 'City Hall' video tape. She witnesses Braddock, a Wildcat in the service of the cult, executing shop owners who stood up to them, and meets the killers themselves: men in tailored black suits with hand-held miniguns, who explode when they die. They call themselves a brotherhood that will bring death on the city; one of them, Claavus, dismisses Darci as 'merely one of the animals'. Officer Bellows turns up suspiciously keen on the crime scene.
characters: **Braddock**: Wildcat, 'servant' of the Men In Black
**Officer Bellows**: takes over the scene, oddly
A tenant hearing men on his roof, a new beach-house owner who hates the UCPD

skymiss2.synopsis: Told by Roper ('now it's my turn to pay her back'). The Wildcats are snatching people off the streets to tie up the police, and they've knocked Darci cold and taken her too. Sent by Captain Falcow, Roper (taken by the cops for an FBI or CIA man) brushes past Sergeant Castor, with an academy friend of Darci's tagging along, frees her, and then they free the other hostages. Wildcats talk of working for Mack Bane 'all along', of big plans for the TV station, and of Bane revealing himself to the Brothers. Darci blows up the trucks before they take the hostages away. (The original's bats are compiled out; the mission asks for them.)
characters: **Sergeant Castor**: in charge at the cordon
**Darci's academy friend**: a cop who insists on coming
Wildcat abductors who want 'the old man'
Vigilante locals who mistake Roper for a Wildcat

factory1.synopsis: Gordansky has revealed what she knew: Mack Bane, candidate in the UC 2000 mayoral race, is the Wildcats' covert leader, and he has subliminal technology that interferes with digital encoding, to be used in a TV address tonight. A hostage situation at the UC Metal Works pulls the police away from the UCNN TV station, and Darci goes as backup. She gets over the perimeter, frees the workers, and secretly finds explosives to blow the TV transmitter before Bane broadcasts. Also: a sniper on a roof, dealers in the parking lot, citizens who heard 'Art Belly' on the radio, and officer Beck, back on duty.
characters: **Cops at the Metal Works**: the man in charge, a terrified three-week rookie, one who hands over his shotgun
A sniper, a Man In Black, a hostile factory workman, dealers, worried citizens

estate2.synopsis: Bane is retreating to his out-of-town estate before fleeing abroad, and the UCPD needs him alive. Darci gets past the guards, Roper (now openly sent by Washington at the Chief's request) saves her life, and she tells him she overheard Wildcats talking about MISSILES aimed at Union City. Inside, Bane speaks to her: he knows her and 'the old man, Roper' and has known them both 'for almost a thousand years'. She has to take the security system offline from the pool house and arrest Bane before his getaway helicopter is refuelled. Killing him, or letting him fly, fails it.
characters: Wildcat guards, cops at the perimeter

Stealtst1.synopsis: Roper searched Bane's estate, pulled the drives and found an encrypted file, 'evidence that Bane is in league with higher forces', but has only half the key. The other half is in the Gaemin Research Center. Darci sneaks in (firing a gun raises the alarm), steals the confidential file, and meets Roper at the front gates in his van. Two guards argue over whether Bane really means 'Armageddon' and the missiles.
characters: Wildcat guards, one a true believer

snow2.synopsis: The decrypted files show Bane and his money men at Gaemin Research have been building missiles in secret. Three launch sites in the Snow Plains, guarded by Wildcats and Bane's personal bodyguards, 'the Fallen' (they look like Wall Street chumps). Darci takes explosives from the village and destroys all three rockets before the warheads are primed. Workmen start the launch sequence if they see her. A Man In Black boasts that 'burning rain' will fall on the city, as Master Bane foresaw.
characters: **The Fallen**: Bane's bodyguards, the Men In Black
Wildcats who say her death was foretold

Gordout1.synopsis: The Fallen cult has overrun the Botanical Gardens district, every civilian has fled, almost all police are pinned down, and no help is coming from the government. Gordansky has been captured again and will be shot in two minutes. Darci gets through the gates, frees her, and leads her to the safe zone. A trapped civilian can be led out too. A Wildcat survivor of Southside wants revenge for his brothers.
characters: A trapped civilian, a drunk tramp, Wildcat guards, Men In Black

Baalrog3.synopsis: Bane has revealed himself to the Wildcats as an ancient warlock, and promised to call 'ancient powers' into Union City. All hell breaks loose on Brick Road: after two Wildcats, a Balrog, a burning giant, appears, and only bullets and blasts can bring it down. 'The Union City ZOO are gonna have a FIELD DAY.'

Finale1.synopsis: Gunston Tower, Clandon Heights. The Wildcats are almost gone and Bane has fled to the rooftops with his last men and his hostages to play out the end of his prophecy. One police team has already been torn apart up there. Roper goes first: he must carry three badly wounded civilians to safety. Then Darci knocks out the two fuel pumps and destroys the fuel reservoir, past steam vents, moving platforms, a gargoyle and Bane himself, who hovers, raises the dead around him, and can't be hurt. (The original plays a video at the end.)
characters: A gargoyle, Men In Black, the last Wildcats

Gangorder1.synopsis: A bonus mission for Mako, unlocked at the very end. A 'head roller': Radar, the Wildcats' eyes and ears on a rooftop, names the target, Corrola, a local politician giving the Boss trouble, now under police protection. Mako and a Wildcat partner hit the escort and kill Corrola, then get back to the hideout. A Wildcat contact wants 'a little talk' with Mako if he makes it back.
characters: A Wildcat contact, an informant, Mako's partner, Corrola's police escort
